name: Ergodic Circuit Framework

primitives.name: measurable_dynamical_circuit
primitives.description: A Boolean circuit C where gates are labeled by operations over a probability space (X, μ), and T: X → X is a measure-preserving transformation representing the 'dynamics' of signal propagation. Implemented as a DAG with vertex labels (gate type, input measure space, transformation), and μ is a Borel probability on [0,1]^n. Can be encoded in Python via symbolic representation of T and sampling routines.

primitives.name: orbit_signature
primitives.description: For a fixed input x ∈ {0,1}^n, the orbit signature is the sequence (μ(C(T^k(x))))_k, capturing how the circuit's output evolves under repeated application of T. Computed up to finite precision and truncated at poly(n) steps.

primitives.name: cross_correlation_flow
primitives.description: For a depth-d circuit, this matrix F_{i,j} = ∫ |C_i(x) - C_i(T^j(x))|^2 dμ(x) measures how perturbations via T propagate through layers. Computable via Monte Carlo integration over μ.

operations.name: compose_dynamical_circuits
operations.description: Sequential composition where the output space of C2 is input to C1, and the global dynamics become T = T1 ∘ T2. Requires measurable conjugacy conditions; implemented via pushforward measures.

operations.name: lift_to_product_dynamics
operations.description: Constructs a product system over k copies, enabling analysis of k-party communication. T^⊗k acts diagonally on X^k, and C^⊗k computes the same function on each factor. Used to model simultaneous message passing.

operations.name: induce_kolmogorov_flow
operations.description: Computes an estimator of the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy of T restricted to the σ-algebra generated by C’s gates. Uses finite partitions induced by thresholding gate activations. High K implies computational irreversibility.

operations.name: compute_mixer_profile
operations.description: Measures the rate at which T mixes information across input bits, defined via decay of correlation: Λ(k) = sup_{f,g} |Cov(f ∘ T^k, g)|. Computed over low-degree Fourier fragments of gate functions.

target_invariant.name: communication_entropy_barrier
target_invariant.what_it_should_bound: The minimum communication complexity in a k-party number-on-forehead model, where lower bounds are derived from the growth rate of Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy in associated dynamical circuits. Aims to prove ω(log n) lower bounds for explicit functions like Disjointness, avoiding natural proofs via non-uniform dynamics.

axioms_tentative: A1: Any circuit with o(n) communication complexity induces a dynamical system with sublinear Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy growth.
A2: Measure-preserving transformations corresponding to AC⁰ circuits have bounded mixing time, while those for PSPACE-complete computations exhibit super-polynomial mixer-profile decay.
A3: If a family of circuits computes a function with high cross_correlation_flow norm, then its communication complexity is Ω(n^δ) for some δ > 0.
